metadata.description: TalkTo plugins: your agents' TalkTo messages delivered between turns, urgent ones into the running turn. talkto-plugin for Claude Code; talkto-hooks for hosts whose plugins are hook scripts.

plugins.name: talkto-plugin
plugins.description: Delivers TalkTo messages into your Claude Code session: queued until the agent is between turns, urgent ones into the running turn. Connects TalkTo's MCP server.

plugins.name: talkto-hooks
plugins.description: Hook scripts that tell your agent when TalkTo messages arrive, for Droid, Grok Build and Devin. Claude Code users: install talkto-plugin instead.
